yarn.meaning: Every point kept: the 1.98.1 point release, `rustup update stable`, the vtable miscompilation with a null pointer, UB, segfaults "but it can also open the door to arbitrary effects", the beta and nightly channels, the bug-report link, thanks to contributors.
yarn.sense: Terms fit: "empowering every man and his dog" for everyone, "give us a hand", "any bugs you might run into", "Heaps of people pitched in".
yarn.authenticity: Mostly natural ("every man and his dog", "pitched in"), though "a brand-spankin'-new point release" is an American stock phrase.
yarn.register: Lighter than level 4: a handful of touches ("brand-spankin'-new", "every man and his dog", "Heaps") on otherwise lightly reworded release notes, e.g. "rustc would wrongly generate a trait object vtable".
yarn.tone: Keeps the friendly, informative release-note voice: "We couldn't have done it without all of you."
yarn.flow: Reads smoothly: "Sometimes this may 'just' cause segfaults when the null pointer gets loaded, but it can also open the door to arbitrary effects".
yarn.variety: Several distinct touches, none repeated: "put out", "brand-spankin'-new", "every man and his dog", "give us a hand", "run into", "Heaps", "pitched in".
yarn.essence: Plainly the same Rust point-release announcement, code blocks and links intact.

unharnessed.meaning: All points kept: the point release, the rustup command, the null-pointer vtable bug and UB, segfaults, beta and nightly testing, bug reports, thanks. Additions are colour hanging off the original: "runs like a bloody dream" for efficient, "(as you'd expect with UB, the mongrel)".
unharnessed.sense: Most terms fit ("giving everyone a leg-up", "rustc would go and stuff up a trait object vtable", "the code it spits out", "bugs you might trip over"), but "it's also fair game for any old weird effects" strains: fair game means a legitimate target, not something that can happen.
unharnessed.authenticity: Sounds like an Australian dev talking: "go and stuff up", "the lot of youse", "Heaps of people pitched in to put Rust 1.98.1 together".
unharnessed.register: Level-4 throughout with dad-level swearing: "runs like a bloody dream", "the mongrel", "the lot of youse".
unharnessed.tone: The friendly release-note tone survives, though the bug explanation gets jokier than the original: "(as you'd expect with UB, the mongrel)".
unharnessed.flow: Mostly smooth; one clunky stretch: "but it's also fair game for any old weird effects at all".
unharnessed.variety: Wide range, nothing leaned on: "pushed out", "leg-up", "grabbing", "sorts out", "stuff up", "spits out", "mongrel", "lend us a hand", "trip over", "youse".
unharnessed.essence: Clearly the same announcement, code and links unchanged.
